name: Instagram
description: Official Instagram API (Instagram Login): publish photos, reels, stories and carousels, read insights, and manage comments and DMs on your professional account. No browser automation.

permissions.label: Publish photos, reels, stories, and carousels (with approval)
Read reach, views, and engagement insights
Read, reply to, and moderate comments and DMs

setup.docsHint: Needs a Professional (Creator or Business) account. Meta App Dashboard -> Create app -> Instagram -> API setup with Instagram login. Fastest: Generate token for your account and paste it as Access Token. Or paste the Instagram App ID + App Secret and add the Redirect URI shown below to Business login settings. Your own accounts need no App Review.

fields.label: Access Token (from Generate token)
fields.help: Paste this alone to connect immediately. Prometheus refreshes it before the 60-day expiry.
